title: Major depression: episode, severity and remission
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's depressive disorder.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for depression.

HPI
The patient is a 73-year-old man who presents today for a scheduled follow-up regarding his depression. He reports that his mood has remained stable over the last month. He notes that he is still experiencing some low energy and a lack of interest in his usual hobbies, but he denies any significant changes in his sleep patterns or appetite. He states that he is managing his symptoms well with his current regimen and reports no new concerns at this time.

Medication List
Sertraline 50mg daily.

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented to person, place, and time. He is cooperative with the interview. His affect is flat but his mood is stable. Speech is normal in rate and volume. Thought process is linear and goal-directed. Physical examination is unremarkable.

Assessment
Depression.

Plan
Continue current dose of Sertraline. The patient will continue to monitor his symptoms and return to the clinic in four weeks for a follow-up evaluation.

Electronically signed, H. Tanaka, PA-C, 10/14/2026
explanations: 'Depression' without 'major depressive disorder' is F32.A, depression unspecified (no HCC). Do not upgrade it to major depression.

distractors.why: Major depressive disorder is not documented.
Neither major depression nor a severity is documented.
